pages.text: Hold Grave Blade in your main hand and press $(k:key.witchersbestiary.legendary_ability). An allied Wraith fights nearby hostile creatures for up to 30 seconds. It has 30 HP and 7 base attack damage.
The Wraith avoids players and protected allies. After the summon, allow 90 seconds before calling another.
Place the Witcher sword first in an anvil and a diamond or netherite sword second. Preview the compatible enchantments. Taking the result consumes the donor. Enchanted books still work.
